title: 皐月賞の後に・冠ゲット☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After winning the first Classic Triple Crown race, the Satsuki Sho, and defeating the other members of the big three, Seiun Sky strikes a rarely seen victorious pose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she can't sit by and idly enjoy the next race—not when it's the dream of her rival Special Week to dominate the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home, Seiun Sky receives a congratulatory phone call from her grandfather. It turns out her participation in the Classics has been his dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite this, she's kept her composure and remained herself. It's time to prepare for the Japanese Derby, the second race of the Classic Triple Crown.
